Bill Sutton was second in the Weight and also gained third place in the Discus, but Bill seems to miss the support of Syd Jones, our other " strong " man, who is in the Services.

It was impossible to include more field events as there were no jumping pits on the ground, and the other displays prevented a Javelin or Discus event being held. We were very glad to welcome Syd Jones in the Weight, and he won with a fine put of 38ft. 11in.

We had no High Jumpers present, and so Charlie Jones " obliged " by just jumping over for third place. Charlie Melchior won the Javelin with a throw of 153 feet, and young Higgins gained third place in this event as he also did in the Discus.

"O.H.M.S. Ashcombe" Jones, who, despite his two score years, has been passed "A.1," and also his proficiency tests, is enjoying himself in Derbyshire, and goes out with Derby and County over the plough.
